_comment: Recommended: global install (npm i -g venice-video-harness venice-video-mcp), then command is just the bin on PATH. Only VENICE_API_KEY is required; HARNESS_WORKSPACE controls where projects land. No global install? Use command 'npx' with args ['-y','venice-video-mcp']. For a local build, use command 'node' with args ['/ABS/PATH/TO/venice-video-mcp/bin/venice-video-mcp.js'] and add HARNESS_BIN or HARNESS_PATH.
